musical.notes: The theme remembered wrongly. The pack labels every hypothetical in text; this labels it by ear, so a counterfactual branch is audibly not history.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental underscore, 60 BPM, D minor, slightly detuned. The same three-note piano figure heard through a music box and a tape machine with unstable speed. Strings a quarter-tone flat. Reversed reverb tails arriving before the notes. Familiar but wrong, as if remembered rather than lived. Thin, uncanny, no percussion.
